note: Cases the engine is known to fail. The gate fails on any failure outside this list and reports any entry that now passes, so it can only shrink. Every case is still classified and reported; nothing here is excluded from the count checks.
recordedFrom: autobahn.yml run 36735219994 (workflow_dispatch on feat/autobahn-deflate, ubuntu-24.04): the target negotiated permessage-deflate, so the full 517-case selection ran for the first time. All 132 group-12/13 entries this file used to carry now pass and were removed. The remaining failures are the eight group-9 rate cases below; the 1024-byte cases the previous recording left open (9.1.1, 9.2.1) passed. Cases 12.4.9 and 12.4.14 failed with 1009 but are not failures: dataset 4 slices a decoded string by code points and its 65536-code-point row encodes to up to 65563 bytes, above the compiled cap, so the harness now classifies them as capacity-blocked.

9.reason: Group 9 is Limits/Performance: each case sends 1000 messages of DATALEN as fast as the peer will take them and the suite marks the case FAILED when the agent cannot sustain the rate, so a failure here is a rate and not a protocol fault. What is listed is the eight run 36735219994 reported as failures. The inbound ring holds 64 messages and the Node main thread drains it, so a burst outruns the consumer. It moves only when the engine thread's drain does, and a rate the pinned build cannot hold is a fact about the build rather than something to argue away in the baseline.

staleAfter: Group 9 moves when the engine thread's drain does, which is the next milestone. Any case the gate reports as now passing must be removed here, and only on the strength of a run: the gate's own report is the observation, not a deduction from the code.
